checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: A tiny robot is visibly present
must.why: Round rusty robot with blue eyes in all frames; it looks large relative to the sunflower in the close-up but reads as small.

must.item: A recognizable sunflower is visibly present
Robot visibly waters the sunflower, water reaching plant or soil
must.why: Water streams from the spout onto the plant base and soil in frames 1-3.

faults.what: Sunflower is not drooping at the start and has little visible change, so the 'perks up' story is weak.
Robot's eyes go dark in frame 2 (a blink), and its hands look slightly odd. Water stops by the end.
Robot's design is a bit rusty and grimy rather than cute. It is large relative to the flower.
The camera push-in crops the robot's body at the end.

summary: A good, warm, golden-hour clip of a blue-eyed robot watering a sunflower, with water reaching the plant and soil; the only flaws are a weak droop-to-perk story and a slightly grimy robot.
